title: Finish a recorded absorption before the target, evidence-table and acceptance gates in decideFinding
body: decideFinding looks up an existing absorption record only after the Target early return, evidenceTable() and acceptance.Decide (absorb.go:130-172). If the epic's acceptance becomes prose or malformed, or runners.toml stops loading, between a warm and a cold incarnation, the recorded decision is never finished: the record exists with no tick, and the re-derivation reaches a smaller epic. Move the recorded-absorption check to right after the standing-draft check.
